name: Jam City
description: '''Jack Louis Latham''' is an English electronic music producer and DJ who performs under the alias '''Jam City'''. He has been active since 2010 and affiliated with the labels [[Night Slugs]] and [[Mad Decent]]. He has released five full-length albums beginning with 2012's ''[[Classical Curves]]''. He has also produced for artists such as [[Kelela]], [[Troye Sivan]], [[Gaika (musician)|Gaika]], and [[Olivia Rodrigo]].
